# 08 — Muğla subsampling

Final validator PASS; schema `mugla_subsampling.v1`; analysis `dd67f701e314263c851e76debdc65854f686a98796b776304a4beeb42f531c5d`. Large data volume contributes to within-region performance, while transfer ordering/asymmetries are largely preserved; Muğla's special role is not explained by total N alone. This is descriptive, not causal. Positives were not matched to Manavgat; all spatial blocks were retained and only within-block density was reduced.
